The '''Listehol system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Located at the intersection of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and the [[Listehol Run/Legends|Listehol Run]], the Listehol system was a notable [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] system.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Port Tooga]] owned by [[Shoola]] the Hutt was a major transshipment point for spices and all kinds of illicit goods along the Hydian Way. The station was located close to the star of the system, where solar winds, stellar ejections, and radiation overwhelmed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] sensors. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Shadow Raptor]]'' visited the station in order to take possession of a group of [[Droid/Legends|droids]], which were actually programmed by the Empire. This eventually led to a [[Shadow Raptor revolt|droid revolt on the ''Shadow Raptor'']].<ref name="DitW" />
